about: O15 feature inventory. Every feature listed here needs at least one passing tester-army test on the exact commit before Dash is installed, promoted, sent over a channel/OTA, or merged (laws/release). Add a feature together with its army test; never list a feature without one, never remove one to get a pass.

features.title: Hosts lists online and recently offline phones, retaining fleet phones and hiding stale ghosts
tests: Hosts lists phones without offering harnesses and hides stale unregistered phones

features.title: Pair with a bridge, Chats tab, open and close a chat window
tests: pairing, Chats tab, open and close real chat window

features.title: Composer send and streamed agent reply
tests: composer typing, Send and streamed ACP reply

features.title: Stop cancels a running turn
tests: Stop cancels an active ACP turn and restores composer

features.title: Queue the next prompt behind a running turn
tests: Queue preserves next prompt and sends after running turn

features.title: Steer a running turn (honest unsupported delivery)
tests: Steer running Hermes turn surfaces unsupported ACP delivery honestly

features.title: File attachments upload to the bridge
tests: file chooser uploads real bytes to isolated bridge
Attach sheet opens on the paperclip with the dock at rest
Attach sheet follows the paperclip when the dock moves after it opens
Attach while the dock is still animating down never shows the sheet away from the paperclip

features.title: Context gauge card
tests: context gauge opens a readable card inside the viewport
context gauge stays pressable while its card is open: pressing it closes the card
safe exploratory controls and context hit target at 390
safe exploratory controls and context hit target at 800

features.title: Long-press the context gauge: a small 20x10 grid peek anchored above it; tap opens the card, tap outside dismisses
tests: context gauge long-press opens a small grid peek just above the gauge
an agent-reported context reading fills the grid in the peek and the card

features.title: Context card draws the 20x10 grid instead of the bar, with Free space and Autocompact buffer rows
tests: context card shows the grid instead of the bar
an agent-reported context reading fills the grid in the peek and the card

features.title: An ACP agent's usage_update reaches the gauge
tests: an agent-reported context reading fills the grid in the peek and the card

features.title: Prompt rail scrub, Jump and Latest, one bar per prompt of a 1000-message chat
tests: prompt rail mouse scrub, Jump and Latest on real transcript
prompt rail keeps the selected turn preview when a live reply completes
every prompt is on the rail, on the right edge clear of the text, and tap and drag jump to the prompt shown
scrolling up while the rest of the chat is still paging in: the view holds, the rail still ends up whole, and the top of the list goes on
a failed older page is retried, so a network blip does not leave the rail partial
the rail is on the left edge and the message text starts clear of it
every Hermes prompt is on the rail, on the right edge clear of the text, and tap and drag jump to the prompt shown

features.title: Harness picker (OMP / Hermes)
tests: harness picker switches OMP to Hermes without sending

features.title: Upstream approvals: dry-run outbox, reject, history
tests: approvals screen reads real dry-run outbox and persists rejection

features.title: Draft text survives close, reopen and reload
tests: draft text survives close, reopen and real browser reload

features.title: Tool, thinking and activity cards are compact and un-nested at phone width
tests: tool and thinking cards stay compact and un-nested at phone width
a long tool stack folds to its header and opens to every row

features.title: Bridge death disables Send; restart reconnects
tests: bridge process death disables Send and restart reconnects

features.title: Agent errors are surfaced and the composer stays usable
tests: real ACP error is surfaced visibly and leaves composer usable

features.title: Chat window identity badge at phone and tablet widths
tests: safe exploratory controls and context hit target at 390
safe exploratory controls and context hit target at 800
host info sheet is compact: provenance inside the sheet, one indent level, session id whole and copyable

features.title: A running turn survives a missing roster row
tests: a missing roster row must not terminate a bridge-owned running turn

features.title: Long-press on a chat row opens the row menu and sends nothing
tests: long-press on a chat row opens the row menu and sends nothing

features.title: Claude Code chats send: a new chat and an archived chat recorded on this host
tests: send to a new Claude Code chat gets a streamed reply
opens sendable (not view-only) from Chats and gets a streamed reply

features.title: The app's socket keepalive is answered with a pong
tests: the app socket keepalive is answered, never logged as ws.bad_message

features.title: Continue a Claude Code chat recorded on another computer: resumed there, reply streamed; unrouted stays view only
tests: resumes on that computer and streams the reply, turn after turn
opens view only and sends nothing

features.title: Roadmap screen: projects, feature filter, task detail with live Hermes and roadmap status
tests: Roadmap -> project -> feature filter -> task detail with live Hermes and roadmap status

features.title: A Hermes chat with delegated workers shows the subagent strip above the composer: live count, newest first, opens to a tree
tests: a Hermes chat with delegated workers shows the subagent strip, newest first, and opens to a tree

features.title: The repository's pm ledger (pm/events.jsonl) parses cleanly and tracks the Hermes tasks
tests: the Dash repository's own pm ledger parses cleanly and tracks the Hermes tasks
